{{Top|leg}}
The '''Borleias Operations''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]] based on the [[Borleias outpost]] and tasked to vigilate to the frontier with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]; it was considered a boring assignment and usually was used for officer and soldiers which made some mistake in their career; at the [[44 ABY]] was commanded by the General [[Eldo Davip]], who sided with Jacen in the civil war.
